Giá cước vận chuyển bị ảnh hưởng bởi nhi.en: Transport prices are affected by various factors, namely: driver's salary, gas costs, car wearout, repair costs, road costs, ... In addition to the overhead costs, you have to add an expensive, advertising fee, ... After determining the above factors, the cost of transportation per shipment will be calculated the appropriate price.
Giá cước vận chuyển bị ảnh hưởng bởi nhi.zh: 运输价格受各种因素影响,即:司机工资,燃气费,汽车疲劳费,修理费,道路费,. 除间接费用外,还要加收昂贵,广告费,. 在确定上述因素后,每批货物的运输费用将按适当的价格计算。
